body.content: Rough fragment: the four guarantees may not be independent. Determinism + polynomial cost smells like a monotone/antitone pair; reinstatement-as-derived is a structural property; valid committed roots is a soundness property. If determinism and polynomial cost jointly force the operator to be a monotone closure operator, then the no-extension theorem reduces to: the grounded operator is the unique monotone closure operator on finite argumentation frameworks that is skeptical-minimal. That would be a clean proof target for candidate 1.
body.why_keep_this: Captures the reduction that would make the ceiling theorem provable rather than conjectural.
